pool.text: The Empire of Trebizond was formed following a Georgian expedition led by Alexios Komnenos.
The Mongol siege of Baghdad diverted more trade caravans towards Trebizond.
The Genoese bought the coastal fortification Leonkastron to secure their Black Sea trade.
Following the great city fire, the ruined university was reestablished.
Tur Ali Beg, an early ancestor of the Aq Qoyunlu, raided Trebizond.
The Black Death arrived at the city probably via Kaffa.
David surrendered Trebizond to Sultan Mehmed II, bringing the city under Ottoman rule.
Suleiman the Magnificent was born in Trabzon.
Trabzon became the capital of its own province, the Eyalet of Trebizond.
The American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions opened the Trebizond Mission station.
A local Greek merchant built the villa known as Atatürk Köşkü.
Stothert & Pitt equipped the Trabzon harbour with cranes.
The Sümer Opera House opened on the central Meydan square.
The city hosted the Trebizond Peace Conference in March and April.
Mustafa Kemal Atatürk stayed in the villa during his visit to Trabzon.
Mustafa Kemal Atatürk stayed at the villa again during a visit.
Dame Rose Macaulay published her last novel, The Towers of Trebizond.
